statement: Purchase Order records SAP S/4HANA implementation milestones, including UAT sign-off and Successful Go-Live as payment conditions.
The record establishes that a Go-Live event occurred on 1 April 2022; Sage relied on the event in asserting implementation success.
Contemporaneous correspondence records operational problems and unresolved implementation issues after Go-Live, which Baidyanath relied on in disputing successful implementation.
The court found that successful Go-Live was not established and that failure to secure UAT sign-off breached the contractual requirements.
